title: Anchor Upward Growing UI Trees
description: When UI trees in bottom-anchored panels grow from bottom to top, expanding a tree item must push content upward while leaving the panel bottom fixed.
summary: Anchored bottom-panel tree content to the block end of its single scroll viewport, removed per-tree nested vertical scrolling, exposed viewport layout classes on Scrollable, and extended the existing bottom-panel regression. The focused regression passes; package typecheck remains blocked by unrelated shared-worktree errors and the local Storybook story frame did not become available for visual verification.
